## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
ROTATION, Growth/Momentum tilt. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmation: narrow leadership concentrated in semiconductors/tech (Top 5: 3/5 Technology) and broad sector participation with Industrials and Financials also positive.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Utilities lead on the week with VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.34% | 1M: +0.13%) and CEG in RECOVERY (1W: +15.10% | 1M: -3.67%). Consumer Discretionary strong: F ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +25.31%), ROST ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.18% | 1M: +3.67%). Technology showing strength concentrated in semis: QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.69% | 1M: +44.88%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy showing weakness with XOM in CORRECTION (1W: -6.65% | 1M: +1.29%) and COP BELOW TREND (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -3.55%). Consumer Staples soft: COST BELOW TREND (1W: -6.83% | 1M: -0.67%), WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.08% | 1M: -8.56%). Communication mixed-to-weak with TTWO in CORRECTION (1W: -8.87% | 1M: +4.71%) and sector down on the week.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%), VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.34% | 1M: +0.13%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.69% | 1M: +44.88%), F ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +25.31%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.09% | 1M: +20.50%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology), signaling concentrated semiconductors-driven strength.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -23.13%), WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.08% | 1M: -8.56%), TTWO CORRECTION (1W: -8.87% | 1M: +4.71%), DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.74%), CME BELOW TREND (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -0.88%). Weakness concentrated in select tech and staples names and parts of Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W momentum: QCOM (1W: +22.19%), VST (1W: +20.34%), AMD (1W: +19.69%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +49.65%), ASML ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.84% | 1M: +12.20%). Major divergence present — multiple large-cap names (META, JPM, CEG, PFE) show 1W vs 1M mismatches; treat as tactical opportunities and watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology performance is concentrated in semiconductors and equipment: QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.69% | 1M: +44.88%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +49.65%); big-cap software is mixed with MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.81%) and INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -23.13%). Sector breadth: Technology positive on the week (aggregate 1W +3.61%; 24 stocks) — internal rotation within tech from software to semiconductors.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are firm but mixed: JPM in RECOVERY (1W: +2.00% | 1M: -0.50%), V in CORRECTION (1W: -1.85% | 1M: +5.73%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -2.21%). Sector breadth: Financials positive on the week (20 stocks) — rotation into select bank/cyclical exposures rather than broad risk-on.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare shows selective strength: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +20.66%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +1.76%); UNH in CORRECTION (1W: -3.65% | 1M: +6.18%), PFE in RECOVERY (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -2.68%). Sector breadth: Healthcare modestly positive (17 stocks) with biotech/pharma news driving dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor semiconductor and select cyclical exposure (QCOM, AMD, INTC, CAT, F) while reducing exposure to idiosyncratic weak large-caps (INTU, WMT, COST). Style: Growth/Momentum within tech semis, but watch broadening participation in Industrials/Financials — remain selective given narrow leadership and major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%) on partnership catalysts; AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.69% | 1M: +44.88%) for continuing semis lift. BEARISH: INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -23.13%) for follow-through downside; WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.08% | 1M: -8.56%) for margin/traffic risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (semiconductors) — concentrated gains to monitor for spillover. BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary — autos/retail strength. BEARISH: Energy — continued weakness and profit-taking; BEARISH: Consumer Staples for idiosyncratic legal/earnings pressure.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA in CORRECTION (1W: -3.36% | 1M: +3.16%) — failure to reclaim last week’s high would extend the pullback; AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +13.85%) — hold of 1W support is needed for continuation; JPM in RECOVERY (1W: +2.00% | 1M: -0.50%) — reclaim of recent 1M highs would confirm rotation into banks.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
QCOM (+55): Qualcomm teaming with ByteDance — QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%) and price is confirming the positive news. ROST (+60): Ross Stores earnings beat — ROST ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.18% | 1M: +3.67%) confirming accumulation. NVDA (+55): CEO comments on Taiwan spend — NVDA in CORRECTION (1W: -3.36% | 1M: +3.16%) shows bullish headlines but short-term price pullback (divergence).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
INTU (-45): Deep job cuts and AI pivot — INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -23.13%) and price confirms negative sentiment. COST (-45): Legal risk headline — COST BELOW TREND (1W: -6.83% | 1M: -0.67%) confirming news-driven weakness. PFE (-50): patent cliff commentary — PFE in RECOVERY (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -2.68%) shows bearish fundamental risk but short-term price bounce (divergence).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Growth/Momentum tilt as semiconductors lead; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology). QCOM, AMD, INTC ABOVE TREND and LLY, F showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (INTU, META, JPM, PFE) and several bullish headlines (NVDA, QCOM) not uniformly translating into broad market participation — monitor for trend confirmation.
